snippet.title: Wyldheart – Demo Launch Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Wyldheart: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642910/Wyldheart/

The Wyldheart demo is OUT NOW on Steam! 

Jump into 1-4 player co-op in this brand-new action RPG, featuring a standalone one-shot adventure created for the demo! With seamless drop-in/drop-out, friends can join when they're free, or you can continue solo when they're not available.

Wayfinder Studios are a small 12-person indie team in Sweden, founded by the former Creative Director of Star Wars Battlefront and joined by the Studio and Technical Directors behind Battlefield and The Finals. Music: A Quiet Song from Afar and Chasing the Traitor by Vindsvept – released under CC-BY 4.0.

Wyldheart Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642910/Wyldheart/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/wyldheart-68afa1

--

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
